decision: Oracle (ORCL) five-year FCFF valuation workbench for a buy-side committee
units: USD millions except per-share amounts and percentages
committee_action: Watch / defer: do not initiate until cash conversion and funding evidence supports a durable FCFF recovery.
conditions: Sustained improvement in FCFF after capacity spending
Net debt stable or declining without unsupported bridge adjustments
Evidence that the capex-intensity fade is credible

reverse_dcf.status: no solution in predeclared search range
reverse_dcf.search_range: uniform additive growth shift from -10.0 to +20.0 percentage points
reverse_dcf.held_fixed: EBIT margins, capex path, tax rate, WACC, terminal growth, bridge

references.basis: Microsoft FY2026 Form 10-K, filed 2026-07-29: GAAP revenue 331,839; diluted EPS 17.95; cash 20,935 plus short-term investments 55,908; current debt 9,227 plus long-term debt 31,067; 7,427m shares outstanding. Price is the 2026-10-16 regular-session close. Qualified reference only because Intelligent Cloud and Dynamics overlap Oracle, while Productivity, gaming, search, and LinkedIn create material mix differences.

Salesforce FY2026 Form 10-K, filed 2026-03-02: GAAP revenue 41,525 and diluted EPS 7.80. Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, filed 2026-08-27: cash 8,310, long-term debt 39,288, and 823m common shares outstanding as of 2026-08-20. Price is the 2026-10-16 regular-session close. Qualified reference only: CRM/SaaS overlap is strong, but Salesforce has different infrastructure intensity and acquisition-related financing.

peer_references.limitation: Microsoft and Salesforce are qualified reference observations, not interchangeable peers or a mechanically averaged valuation range.

limitations: Forecast paths are analyst judgments, not company guidance.
Microsoft and Salesforce are reference observations, not a peer-set valuation or a mechanical average.
Bridge excludes any unsourced adjustments for leases, preferred, or other claims.
Terminal-value share makes the long-run capex, WACC, and terminal-growth assumptions load-bearing.
